title: Security event viewer with exportable filters and saved views
creator: Ava Patel
description: Background: Security and compliance teams need a first-class console experience for investigating events (user actions, auth events, policy changes) that can be filtered, paginated, and exported for downstream audits. Current viewer is inconsistent across tenants, lacks saved queries, and times out on large result sets. Scope: build a robust Security Event Viewer (SEV) that supports multi-field filtering, cursor-based pagination, CSV and JSON export (background jobs for large exports), saved queries per-org, and RBAC V2 enforcement so only permitted roles can view/export events. Also ensure SSO/SAML sessions respect org-specific retention and that export events are themselves logged for chain-of-custody. Out of scope: long-term cold storage UI and raw ELK access.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Console shows security events with filters for time range, actor, resource, action, outcome, and IP; 2) Pagination uses opaque cursors and supports page size up to 1000 with stable ordering by event timestamp desc; 3) Inline quick-export (small result sets <= 5k) returns CSV/JSON synchronously; 4) Large exports (>5k) spawn background job, show progress in Notifications, and provide download link; 5) Exports capped at 100k rows per job with clear messaging and option for split exports; 6) Saved queries can be created/edited/deleted by users with "saved_query_write" permission and shared with team; 7) RBAC v2 roles respected: only roles with audit_read can view, audit_export for export actions, superadmin for org-wide exports; 8) Each export and viewer access generates an immutable audit event that records requester, role, filter set, and export job id; 9) Works with SSO/SAML sessions and honors session expiry (no elevated access after logout); 10) Performance: initial query latency <500ms for 1k-item requests on production-sized clusters or fallback to pre-signed export job within 2s.
technical_notes: - Query layer: use search service over RedEventStream with indexed fields (timestamp, actor_id, actor_email, resource_type, action, outcome, ip). - Pagination: implement opaque cursor encoding last_seen_timestamp + shard_cursor; avoid OFFSET/limit to maintain performance. - Export: synchronous path uses streaming CSV writer; async path files written to private org S3 with presigned expiring link and size limit. - RBAC: hook into RBAC v2 middleware; export endpoints require explicit audit_export permission; UI must hide export buttons when not permitted. - Saved queries: lightweight metadata stored in Console DB (org_id, owner, name, filters_json), but filters canonicalized server-side to avoid stale schema. - SSO/SAML: verify session binding by including assertion id in export audit event; if session revoked, background job checks token validity before starting. - Rate-limiting: exports counted against org export quota; throttle to avoid impacting serving runtime. - Telemetry: add metrics for export job counts, average export size, failures, and viewer query latency.
rollout_plan: 1) Feature flag behind console.feature.security_event_viewer; 2) Week 1: internal dogfood on staging with small customer tenants; 3) Week 2: limited beta opt-in for 5 customers (security teams) with manual monitoring; 4) Week 3: lift beta after success metrics (error rate <1%, avg export time <3m for 100k rows). 5) Post-rollout: enable org defaults and notify customers in console release notes. - Rollback: disable feature flag and delete incomplete export jobs created after flag enable.
